decisions.hidden_reasoning:

Working through the speed tie scenario, my Dragon Claw lands around 150-177 damage against their 185 HP mega Garchomp, not quite a KO, and they'd likely hit me comparably hard back. I'm weighing alternatives like switching to Gholdengo or Dragonite, but Dragonite's lower speed means it won't outpace them either, so trading Dragon Claws now seems best — even if we both end up low, Dragonite's Extreme Speed can clean up afterward.

decisions.hidden_reasoning:

Still, striking with Dragon Claw now while I have the speed advantage seems like the right call.
